title: Product Media Buy Support
description: Product-scoped capabilities that participate in shared MediaBuy-level execution. Every selected product must positively advertise the relevant capability. This is separate from overlay_support because a shared MediaBuy counter is not a package targeting overlay. Extension-only objects do not advertise support.

frequency_cap.description: This product can participate in the seller's shared counter for a root MediaBuy.frequency_cap. A buy mixing this product with one that lacks this declaration, or whose resolved supported_per_units omits the root cap's per value, is rejected atomically.
